verdict.rationale: SigNoz is open source and self-hostable via Docker, Kubernetes, or Linux, and community comments confirm a Docker path exists, so you don't need a full k8s cluster to run it locally. Hands-on reports show friction: the docker-compose setup has many services and more containers than some users' whole apps, and one Windows install failed on sh/bash dependencies. missing for 10: a lightweight single-container dev mode, first-party docs detailing a local/dev quickstart, and working Windows-native install instructions.
